# Northern Tier Conservation Programs

![](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/Outdoor
Program/Conservation/images/ntier.jpg)

![](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/Outdoor
Program/Conservation/images/ntier_forest_corps.jpg)![](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/Outdoor
Program/Conservation/images/ntier_forest_corps.jpg)

### Northern Tier Forest Corps

Forest Corps is a coed two-week leadership training course for outdoor
enthusiasts. The course consists of 10 days of canoeing and camping in the
Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness (BWCAW) and includes training in
conservation, Leave No Trace, field science, and outdoor education.

More information



### Northern Tier O.A. Wilderness Voyage and Canadian Odyssey

![](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/Outdoor
Program/Conservation/images/ntier_wilderness.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20210%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)
The Order of the Arrow Wilderness Voyage and Canadian Odyssey programs are an
experience like no other. For two weeks, Arrowmen from around the country join
together and give back to the Canoe Country region through portage trail
restoration work. Participants have an opportunity to leave a mark on the
Border Lake region that will enable millions of visitors each year to better
enjoy their experience. Trail work involves restoring and protecting trails
that have existed for centuries and are in dire need of repair.

More information

### Northern Tier Leave No Trace Level 2 Instructor Course

(Formerly called a Master Educator Course)

Northern Tier offers a BSA [Leave No Trace](http://www.lnt.org/) Level 2
Instructor course each summer.  This five-day course features a day on base of
lectures before a four-day immersive wilderness classroom experience.  The
class is designed to teach Leave No Trace instructors the pedagogical methods
necessary to instruct others in Leave No Trace ethics. After graduating the
class, participants will be able to teach BSA Leave No Trace 101 sessions,
Leave No Trace Skills courses, and Leave No Trace Level 1 Instructor courses.

[More information](https://www.ntier.org/training/)
